body.condition: For every \(Q\in\mathcal K\), one common \(\mathcal E_T\) dominates in absolute value every coordinate of \([\phi_T(\xi;P_\xi)]_Q\), \([I_T(\xi)]_Q\), \([\zeta_T(\xi)]_Q\), and \([\psi_{\theta,T}(\xi)]_Q\), every test function in \(\mathcal F_{0X,T}\), and every message derivative through total order three appearing in \(\mathfrak R_T\), \(\dot{\mathfrak R}_T\), \(\Psi_T\), or \(D\Psi_T\).
